title: FINISHER
why: His yes to a finisher. Hold the crowbar key, V, on a pillager who is down on the floor and within reach, and after about half a second you finish him on the spot: a heavy blow, a kick of the screen, 100 added to your run score in a DEMO run and a CAREER run, and the kill counts for you as any of your kills does. It is the answer to his one get-up: you can end him before he is back on his feet. A tap on V is still the crowbar swing and nothing else, and a pillager who is standing is never touched. A downed pillager in reach shows FINISH and the key over him, with a ring that fills while you hold. On a linked window the host does the killing.
now: Hold V on a downed pillager to finish him for a score bonus.
